reformulationNotes: C4 Original WAS reformulated, as part of Nutrabolt's 5th-generation C4 line announced February 18, 2024. The PRE-2024 formula (per ~6-6.5 g scoop) was: 150 mg caffeine anhydrous, 1.6 g CarnoSyn beta-alanine, 1 g creatine nitrate, roughly 1 g of citrulline malate and/or arginine AKG (reviews of different label revisions differ), an 'Explosive Energy Blend' (~371 mg) containing N-acetyl-L-tyrosine, velvet bean seed extract and theacrine with undisclosed splits, plus vitamin C (~250 mg) and niacin (~30 mg). The current 5th-generation formula roughly doubles the scoop to ~9 g, raises caffeine to 200 mg and beta-alanine to 2 g, replaces the old pump base with the fully disclosed 2.4 g Velox L-citrulline/L-arginine blend, keeps 1 g NO3-T creatine nitrate, adds 100 mg PeptiPump bioactive lentil peptides and 5 mg toothed clubmoss (50 mcg huperzine A), switches B-vitamins to active forms (pyridoxal-5-phosphate, methylcobalamin), adds 225 mg choline, and eliminates proprietary blends entirely. CAUTION for the comparison site: Cellucor still hosts a live legacy product page (cellucor.com/products/c4-original-old) with the 150 mg formula, and old-formula 60-serving stock still circulates (e.g. Amazon ASIN B00U464HYK's title still advertises 150 mg caffeine) - any C4 Original panel found in the wild must be checked for PeptiPump/Velox rows to confirm it is the current label. C4 Sport, C4 Ultimate, C4 Ripped and C4 Energy (ready-to-drink) are separate product lines, not this product.
gaps: The assigned researcher for this product returned no dossier at all; this file was assembled in a single pass by the audit gate on 2026-07-27 from the 10 sources listed, and is thinner than the Gorilla Mode and Pulse dossiers (fewer independent transcriptions per number).

Only one complete supplement-facts transcription was found (NutriCartel). The active doses (caffeine 200 mg, beta-alanine 2 g, Velox 2.4 g at 1.2 g/1.2 g, creatine nitrate 1 g, PeptiPump 100 mg, toothed clubmoss 5 mg) are independently corroborated by PricePlow's dose-by-dose coverage and partially by Cellucor's and GotProtein's callouts, but the vitamin and choline rows (B6 3.4 mg, folate 100 mcg DFE, B12 6 mcg, choline 225 mg) rest on the single NutriCartel transcription; PricePlow confirms the forms (P5P, methylcobalamin, choline bitartrate) but not the amounts.

Serving-size discrepancy: NutriCartel's panel transcription reads 9 g per level scoop while PricePlow's article says 8.9 g; stale listings elsewhere show 8.3 g and ~6 g (old formula). Used 9 g. Net tub weight was never confirmed (9 g x 30 implies ~270 g).
No value was read directly from Cellucor's own supplement facts panel, which is published only as an image.

Label warnings are incomplete: only the 8-week continuous-use warning and the stimulant-combination warning were retrieved; the standard age/pregnancy/physician-consultation block was not transcribed from the actual label.
A sodium row, if present on the panel, was not captured; only 10 calories and 1 g carbohydrate were transcribed.

Flavor list is low confidence: the brand-site selector showed the 6 flavors recorded, but a Bubble Yum collaboration flavor exists per PricePlow, Walmart lists a Popsicle Grape 25-serving SKU, and NutriCartel used variant names (Fruit Juicy Red, Cherry Popsicle); production versus limited-edition status was not determined.
Dyes vary by flavor: FD&C Red #40 comes from a red-flavor panel transcription; the specific artificial color in each other flavor (e.g. Icy Blue Razz) was not verified.
Amazon could not be verified: listing bodies were not retrievable, so amazonTypical is null and Amazon review counts and gallery contents are unknown; only search-result listing titles were seen.

No banned-substance certification (Informed Sport / NSF Certified for Sport) was found for C4 Original - the NSF Certified for Sport product in this family is the separate C4 Sport line; the absence is inferred from not finding a listing rather than an explicit manufacturer statement.

The pre-2024 formula description in reformulationNotes is medium confidence, assembled from Garage Gym Reviews' review of the 150 mg formula and older listing titles; the old Explosive Energy Blend's exact composition and the arginine-AKG versus citrulline-malate question were not fully resolved.
The February 18, 2024 launch date comes from a PR Newswire release surfaced in search results that was not fetched directly.
The 25-serving and 50-serving SKUs were not priced; perServing covers the 30-serving tub only.
